name: Can minor drywall damage and settling cracks be fixed during an interior paint job?

mainEntity.name: Can minor drywall damage and settling cracks be fixed during an interior paint job?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, drywall patching and crack repairs are essential parts of our interior painting process. Because HH Remodeling specializes in drywall installation and repair alongside painting, our team fixes settling cracks, nail pops, doorknob holes, and water-damaged sections before applying any paint. We blend textures—such as knockdown, orange peel, or smooth finishes—so patched areas disappear completely. Addressing underlying drywall flaws ensures the fresh coat of paint adheres properly and looks seamless under natural and artificial light.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Our team repairs cracks, holes, and texture mismatches prior to painting so surfaces look completely uniform and smooth.
